title: Plant-Wide Hierarchical Electricity-Heat Coordination for Large-Scale Cold-Region ReP2H Plants via Bidirectional Thermal Coupling
summary: Large-scale renewable power-to-hydrogen (ReP2H) plants in cold regions suffer from prolonged startup and repeated thermal stress during frequent startup-shutdown operation. The situation becomes worse due to the lack of coordinated heat management among the alkaline electrolysis stacks, balance of plant (BoP), plant thermal utility system (PTUS), and plant building. This paper presents a plant-wide thermal topology and a hierarchical electricity-heat management framework to address the issues.
